name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/tags-core
description: The tag system's shared logic for Quartz 5 plugins: the resolution rule, the shapes the cgc-tags engine publishes, their fileData types, and a colour resolver for canvases. See CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Source only: no build and no dist. The consuming plugin's build inlines it (ADR-0005). `./colour` is browser-only.
//devDependencies: Types only. `vfile` is the module the fileData augmentation extends; a consuming plugin resolves its own copy, the host Quartz's.
